purpose: Maintain one focus quest plus two staged successor quests so explicit NEXT cycles can continue for long engagements without collapsing into one-task-at-a-time orchestration.

window.rotation: Q1 complete => Q2 focus; Q3 shifts forward; Q4 reseeds from canonical Rehydration Successor baton

algorithm: verify pipeline Q1 equals loop current task
require substantive Git delta outside loop/pipeline/message-board bookkeeping
compile far-end Q4 from residual/candidate evidence with canonical SuccessorCompiler while deliberately omitting staged Q2
advance RehydrationLoop with self_steer=false and next_task forced to staged Q2
rotate pipeline Q1->history, Q2->focus, Q3->stage, Q4->far-end reseed
return both loop and pipeline receipts

invariants: exactly one Q1 focus when ACTIVE
Q2 and Q3 are staged context, not hidden background execution
ACTIVE window contains exactly three concrete quests
only Q1 may complete and rotate the window
Q4 is derived from a valid canonical successor baton
a SELECTED successor cannot be silently replaced by a lower-ranked candidate
ambiguous Q4 remains RESEED_HOLD until explicitly resolved
a pending reseed hold must be resolved before another focus rotation
completed tasks are not silently revisited by default
bookkeeping-only Git deltas do not count as substantive quest progress in composite NEXT
pipeline state is Git persisted and state-digest guarded
pipeline routing grants no execution, evidence, promotion, release, deployment, or merge authority
